content: Attendee Fields Event Organizers can use the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_ETSetting_AllowEditAtten}} field to control whether {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s can change their personal information in the {{variable.Product_BlackthoEventNavigator}} app. Mobile Device ID When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} opens the Navigator app, the {{variable.Field_Attendee_MobileDeviceID}} field on the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} object automatically stores the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s mobile device ID. Event Organizers can then use the {{variable.Field_Attendee_MobileDeviceID}} to perform the following tasks. Push Notifications Users with the Blackthorn | Events (Organizer) permission set can send push notifications via the Smart Scheduler to {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s’ mobile devices via the Navigator app, alerting them to time-sensitive information such as a venue location change. NOTE: Only users with the Blackthorn | Events (Admin) permission set can edit the {{variable.Field_Attendee_MobileDeviceID}} field. Send a Push Notification Before beginning the process, register yourself for the {{variable.Object_Event}} , log into the Navigator app with your phone, and get the {{variable.Field_Attendee_MobileDeviceID}} from your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record. Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} record. Click the Communication tab. Click New Message . Recipient Section Select “a Push Notification.” Select either “Event Attendees” or “Session Attendees.” Enter a {{variable.Field_SmartSche_ScheduleName}} . Choose an Attendee Filter. If you set Attendee Filter = “Attendance Status”, select the relevant options in the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_AttendStatus}} field. If you set Attendee Filter = “Registration Status”, select the relevant options in the {{variable.Field_ETAttendee_RegistrStatus}} field. There must be at least one recipient listed in {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}} . If a zero is listed under {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}} , check that you have the correct status selected and review the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s that should have the chosen status. If you hover over the {{variable.Field_SmartSche_TotalRecipient}} , you will see the list of Attendees who will receive the message. The push notification sender will be maintained from the API, and the receiver (Attendee) will be the {{variable.Field_Attendee_MobileDeviceID}} , which is stored in the Attendee record page. It isn’t available on the Communication tab. Click {{variable.Button_Next}} . Schedule Section Choose one of the three options below to schedule your push notification. Send the push notification at a specific date and time. Choose the specific date and time in the Select a Date / Time field. Send the push notification X Minutes/Hours/Days After/Before the selected trigger. Enter the number. Choose “Days”, “Hours”, or “Minutes”. Select “Before” or “After”. Choose “Event Start Date/Time”, Event End Date/Time”, “Event Attendee Registration Date”, or “Event Attendee Created Date”. Select Now to send the push notification two minutes after it is scheduled. Click {{variable.Button_Next}} . Message Section Enter a message in the {{variable.Field_SMSTemplate_Body}} field. Click {{variable.Button_Next}} . Send Test Section Sending a test push notification is optional. Complete the following fields. Test Mobile Device Id(s) - Enter the {{variable.Field_Attendee_MobileDeviceID}} stored in your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record. Test Record - Select your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} record. Click Send Test . When you are ready to send the push notification, click Schedule . You will see the scheduled push notification in the Communication tab. You can also edit a push notification that is in draft {{variable.Field_SMSMessage_Status}} from the Event record or from the Global Scheduler by clicking the Edit button next to the notification. Confirm Attendee Login Event Organizers can confirm if an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has logged into the app by checking the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} ’s {{variable.Field_Attendee_MobileDeviceID}} field. If the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has logged in, their mobile device ID will populate the field. Usage Data Event Organizers can pull reports that include the number of {{variable.Object_Attendee}} records with the {{variable.Field_Attendee_MobileDeviceID}} field populated. Event Registration Submission Record When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} registers for a {{variable.Object_Session}} from the Navigator app, a new {{variable.Object_EventRegistrationSub}} record will be created. The data saved will include the {{variable.Object_ERS}} record’s new {{variable.Field_ERS_PayloadSource}} field with one of the following values: “Event Checkout,” “Session Checkout,” or “Mobile Check-In.” Clearing the Cache The app will clear the cache related to the Navigator app in the following scenarios. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} switches between organizations. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} signs out passively or uses the app infrequently. The {{variable.Object_Attendee}} clicks Sign Out to sign out of the app. Using Track Records Use Track records to divide Sessions into categories and help Attendees filter their Agenda based on individual Tracks. Track records work the same in the Navigator app as they do on Event webpages. You can also pre-assign Attendees to Tracks, limiting the Sessions they can register for. Click here for steps to create Tracks and assign them to Sessions and Attendees. WiFi If an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} opens and starts using the app or “loads the data” before their device goes offline, the data will be readable in the app. {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will receive a notification that their device is offline.
